name: Feel No Pain
game_text: Reduce damage taken by physical and energy sources by 1 while in the Green zone, 2 in the Yellow zone, and 3 in the Red zone.

name: Grin and Bear It
game_text: Defend using [quality] and use your Mid+Min dice. Recover Health equal to your Max die.

name: Lash Out
game_text: Attack using [power]. If you are Green status, use your Max die. If you are Yellow status, use the Max+Min dice. If you are Red status, use Max+Min against one target and Mid against another.

name: Living Wall
game_text: When a nearby ally would be Attacked, you may become the target of that Attack instead. You may use this reaction any number of times in a round by taking 1 irreducible damage for each time past the first.

name: Toss Hero
game_text: Attack using [power] and use your Max die. Either Hinder that target with your Mid die or Attack another nearby target with your Mid die. The first question to answer is how a villain reacts in certain situations, and what they care about as a villain. Some are their most powerful when they’re surrounded by inventions of their own devising. Others work well in groups. Some care about how hurt they are, just like heroes. Choose an archetype from the following list. Fill the status dice in the appropriate section of the villain sheet.

name: Ascend From My Realm
game_text: Ignore damage from an environment source during the environment’s turn.

name: The Earth Trembles Around You
game_text: Roll any number of environment minion dice. Attack every target in the scene (other than yourself) with those dice. Remove those minions. Power Heeds My Call in

name: All Forms
game_text: Remove any number of environment-created bonuses. For each bonus removed, you may Attack one target using your Mid die, using a different bonus against each.

name: This Place is Mine to Command
game_text: Activate one of the environment’s twists in its current zone or one zone closer to red.

name: The World Moves to Defend Me
game_text: When Attacked, redirect the Attack to an environment minion.

name: Channel Greatness
game_text: Boost using [power] and use your Max die. That bonus is persistent and exclusive. Also Attack with your Mid die.

name: Cleansing Elevation
game_text: Boost using [power] and use your Max+Min dice. Remove all penalties on yourself.

name: Expended Negation
game_text: Destroy one of your bonuses. Deal each opponent damage equal to the value of that bonus.

name: Share in your Glory
game_text: Boost yourself using [power] and use your Max die. Boost a nearby ally with your Mid die and Boost another nearby ally using your Min die.

name: Unrivalled Paragon
game_text: Take any basic action and use your Max die.

name: Untempered Grit
game_text: Ignore all penalties on you for your action. Take irreducible damage equal to the total of those penalties.

name: Careless Smash
game_text: Attack using [power] and use your Max+Mid dice. Hinder yourself with your Min die.

name: Dismantling Jab
game_text: Attack using [quality]. Then remove all bonuses from the target.

name: Escape Plan
game_text: Whenever your personal zone changes, you may immediately move elsewhere in the scene.

name: Shrouded Attack
game_text: Attack using [quality] and use your Max die. Defend against all Attacks against you with your Min die until the start of your next turn.

name: Versatile Strike
game_text: Attack using [quality] and use your Max die. If you are at full Health, this Attack deals irreducible damage and cannot be reacted to. If you are in the Green zone but not at full health, Defend yourself with your Min die. If you are in the Yellow zone, Boost yourself with your Min die. If you are in the Red zone, Recover Health equal to your Min die.

name: Close Quarters Combat
game_text: Attack multiple close targets using [quality]. Hinder each target using your Min die.

name: Even Odds
game_text: At the start of your turn, gain a bonus equal to the number of opponents that Attacked you since your last turn.

name: Fighting Rhythm
game_text: Attack using [quality], using the Max die against one target, Mid die against a different target, and the Min die against a third target. If you Attack three different targets, the damage is irreducible.

name: Human Shield
game_text: Attack one target using [quality] and use your Max+Min dice. Defend against all Attacks made by targets other than that target with your Mid die until the start of your next turn. All Defended damage is dealt to the target of your Attack.

name: Malicious Deflection
game_text: Defend against an Attack by rolling your single status die. Deal that much damage to a different nearby target.

name: Tangled Fray
game_text: If you are outnumbered by nearby opponents, reduce all damage dealt to you by 2.

name: Absorb Energy
game_text: Defend by rolling your single status die. If that defense reduces the damage to 0, Boost using the amount of damage prevented.

name: Grab and Drag
game_text: Attack using [power]. Either Hinder that target using Max, or Defend yourself using Min and you and that target end up elsewhere in the scene.

name: Heavy Duty
game_text: Reduce damage dealt to you by 2.

name: Prepare for the Worst
game_text: Boost yourself using [quality] and use your Max die. That bonus is persistent and exclusive.

name: Suppressive Fire
game_text: Attack multiple targets using [quality]. Hinder those targets using your Min die.

name: Unflagging
game_text: Attack using [power] and use your Max die. Recover Health equal to your Min die.

name: Area Suppression
game_text: Hinder using [power] against multiple targets and use your Max die. Attack one of those targets with your Mid die.

name: Overwhelming Syphon
game_text: Each hero loses Health equal to the total penalties on them. Recover the same amount of Health. Remove those penalties.

name: Targeted Drain
game_text: Hinder using [power] and use your Max+Mid dice, or use your Max die and make it persistent and exclusive.

name: Tethered Life
game_text: Hinder using [power]. That penalty is persistent and exclusive. As long as that penalty is in play, reduce damage dealt to you by 1 and whenever you are dealt damage, the target with this penalty takes 1 irreducible damage.

name: Twisted Fate
game_text: Select a nearby target. Either turn all bonuses on that target to equivalent penalties, or move a penalty from that target to another target that you can see.

name: Upper Handed Strike
game_text: When Attacked by someone with a penalty you created, Defend by rolling your single status die, and the attacker also suffers that much damage.

name: Capable Creator
game_text: Whenever you create a bonus, increase that bonus by 1.

name: Cut Both Ways
game_text: Boost using [power]. Hinder with your Max die. Attack with your Min die.

name: Empowered Destruction
game_text: Attack using [power] and at least one bonus. Use your Max+Mid+Min dice and add all of your bonuses to it, destroying them.

name: Leverage Advantage
game_text: Attack using [power] and at least one bonus. If you have multiple bonuses, you may also Attack another target using the Min die and one other bonus, and may also Attack a third target using the Max die and a third bonus.

name: To Serve their Maker
game_text: Discard one of your bonuses to Defend against all Attacks against you until your next turn, using that bonus value as the Defend result.

name: Variable Creating
game_text: Boost using [power] and use your Max die, also Boost with your Mid die, and either make one of those bonuses persistent and exclusive or Attack with your Min die.

name: Divide and Conquer
game_text: When you would take physical damage, prevent that damage and create a minion with a die size equal to your current status die (including the newly made minion). You may use this reaction more than once a round, but each time you use this reaction after the first time, you take 1 irreducible damage.

name: Instability of Form
game_text: Whenever a Legion minion larger than a rolls a save against physical damage, if its save is successful, it splits into two dice of one smaller size instead of being reduced a die size, and you take 1 irreducible damage. If it fails its save, the minion is only reduced one die size, rather than being destroyed.

name: Parts of the Whole
game_text: Roll your single status die. Deal yourself that much irreducible damage. Create that many minions.

name: Returned Vitality
game_text: When one of your minions is destroyed, roll its die. You Recover that much Health.

name: Split Up
game_text: Add two minions of size equal to one die size lower than your current status.

name: Combine
game_text: Remove any number of Legion-controlled minions. Roll their dice and Recover that much Health.

name: Uncoordinated Actions
game_text: Whenever multiple Legion minions all take the same action against the same target, you must roll all of their dice at the same time and use the lowest rolling die amongst them for each minion’s result on that action.

name: Antisocial Behavior
game_text: Hinder multiple targets using [power/quality]. Recover Health equal to the number of targets Hindered this way.

name: Best on my Own
game_text: Attack using [power] and use your Max die. Recover Health equal to your Mid+Min dice.

name: Better Them than Me
game_text: When a non-minion ally in this scene is defeated, roll your single [quality] die as a Boost for yourself.

name: Singular Strength
game_text: As long as you have no nearby allies in the scene, increase all damage you deal by 1 and reduce all damage you take by 1.

name: Thin the Herd
game_text: Attack multiple targets using [power]. Hinder each target with your Max die.

name: Worst Case Response
game_text: When you would be Hindered or when an Attack would reduce you to 0 Health, reduce the penalty to -1 or reduce that damage to 1.

name: By My Command
game_text: Boost using [quality] for all your minions until the start of your next turn.

name: Give Me Your Strength
game_text: Roll all your minion dice and combine the result to Boost. Attack using [power] and use that bonus. “Look Out, Boss!” R Redirect an Attack to one of your minions.

name: Rapid Deployment
game_text: Use [quality] to create a number of minions equal to the value of your Max die. The starting die size for those minions is the same as the size of your Min die.

name: Form Up
game_text: Attack using [power] and use your Max die. Defend against all Attacks against you until the start of your next turn using the number of your minions.

name: Surprise Trap
game_text: When Attacked, roll your single status die. Hinder the Attack using that result, and deal damage to the attacker equal to that penalty.

name: Hazardous Terrain
game_text: Hinder multiple targets using [power]. Use your Max die. Attack any target that gains a penalty this way that already had one penalty from you, using your Mid+Min dice.

name: Hidden Hunter
game_text: Double any bonuses or penalties of your choice involved with taking action against a target that is unaware of your presence or distracted from remembering that you’re still around.

name: Hunt the Weak
game_text: Attack using [quality]. Use your Max die. If the target has a penalty you created or is in the Red zone, use your Max+Mid dice instead.

name: Stealth Approach
game_text: Boost yourself using [quality]. Use your Max die. That bonus is persistent and exclusive. Defend using your Mid die against all Attacks until the start of your next turn.

name: Track my Prey
game_text: Hinder using [power]. Use your Max die. That penalty lasts until your next turn, and while that penalty lasts, that hero cannot use reactions and cannot benefit from Defend actions.

name: On My Mark
game_text: One ally makes a basic action now, using their Max die. They reroll all 1s they roll as part of this action.

name: My Allies are my Strength
game_text: Increase damage you deal by the number of nearby non-minion allies.

name: Press the Advantage
game_text: Attack using [quality] and use your Max die. If you choose that target to go next, they must Attack you on their turn if possible.

name: Protect My Allies
game_text: When another villain is Attacked, Defend against the Attack by rolling your single status die. Boost yourself using the amount of damage reduced.

name: Take Point
game_text: Attack using [quality]. Use your Max die. Defend all nearby allies with your Mid+Min dice until the start of your next turn.

name: Crush All Underfoot
game_text: Attack using [power] against multiple targets. Hinder those targets with your Min die.

name: Down the Hatch
game_text: Attack using [power] and use your Max die. The target can either be Hindered equal to your Max+Mid+Min dice, or be unable to take any other actions other than using an Overcome to attempt to escape.

name: Foolish Insect
game_text: When a hero takes a minor twist in the Titan’s challenge, in addition to the chosen twist, also roll your status die and deal that much damage to that hero.

name: You Are But Gnats to Me
game_text: Reduce all damage taken by 6 (if you have a status die), 4 (if you have a status die) or 2 (if you have a or lower status die). I Will Not be Defeated

name: So Easily
game_text: When Attacked by a roll that includes doubles, remove one of the successes from the Titan’s challenge.

name: The Land Quakes Underfoot
game_text: Activate one of the environment’s twists in its current zone.
